stages.headline: A collection is solved by numbers satisfying at least one of its parts — the union; it is written with a square bracket.
stages.headlineEnglish: A collection is solved by numbers satisfying at least one of its parts — the union; it is written with a square bracket.

stages.headline: On the number line take both parts.
stages.headlineEnglish: On the number line take both parts.

stages.headline: Collections appear e.g. when a product equals zero: (x − 2)(x + 5) = 0 ⇔ x = 2 or x = −5.
